Specialty: Surgery
Year: 2024

Examiner: Dr. Ahmed Hassan
Case: Acute Appendicitis

Q1. What are the complications of appendectomy?
A1: Wound infection, bleeding, adhesions, intra-abdominal abscess.
Q2. How do you confirm the diagnosis?
A2: Clinical assessment plus ultrasound; CT if uncertain.
Q3: What is the differential diagnosis?

Examiner: Dr. Sara Al-Kadhimi
Case: Bowel Obstruction

1. What are the causes of intestinal obstruction?
2. Mention the initial management steps.
A: IV fluids, nasogastric tube, analgesia, keep nil by mouth.

Examiner: د. علي الجبوري
Case: Thyroid Swelling
السؤال 1: ما هي مضاعفات استئصال الغدة الدرقية؟
الجواب: نزف، اصابة العصب الحنجري الراجع، نقص كالسيوم الدم.
